clause: Enhance — ML-adapter tier + re-editability lifecycle + receipts [STU-RAW-014b,STU-RAW-014c]

scope.summary: Implement the ML-model-backed Enhance tier (AI denoise, AI raw-details, AI super-resolution) ONLY as an optional StudioModelAdapter, local model preferred, no required cloud/account. When no adapter is installed the pipeline MUST fall back to the deterministic tier (MT-427) and surface a capability receipt rather than failing. An Enhance result MUST remain re-editable: an update/flatten lifecycle refreshes AI results when models change and flattens to a baked buffer with a documented reset path back to the editable state; every Enhance run MUST emit a receipt naming the adapter, the model identity, and whether it ran locally.
acceptance_criteria: ML Enhance optional adapter; degrades to deterministic with receipt; re-editable update/flatten; run receipts
proof_targets: ML-adapter + no-adapter-degrade + re-edit lifecycle + receipt test
expected_tests: negative: no adapter -> falls back to deterministic tier + capability receipt (no failure)
test: Enhance result re-editable; update/flatten + reset path; run receipt names adapter+model+local-flag

target_entries: Studio / Camera Raw & Develop / Enhance — AI (optional)

risk_if_missed: ML Enhance becomes hard cloud dependency; results non-re-editable; unaudited model runs.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
